metadata.title: Next-Day Risk & Return Machine Learning Platform

ret.name: Daily Log Return %
ret.description: Logarithmic price return of the primary asset over the most recent 1-day period.

ret_lag_1.name: Return Lag 1
ret_lag_1.description: Log return from 1 day prior, capturing short-term mean-reversion or momentum.

ret_lag_5.name: Return Lag 5
ret_lag_5.description: Log return from 5 days prior (1 full trading week lag).

drawdown_60d.name: 60-Day Peak Drawdown %
drawdown_60d.description: Percentage decline from the rolling 60-day price peak.

vol_5d.name: 5-Day Realized Volatility %
vol_5d.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over a 1-week rolling window.

vol_20d.name: 20-Day Realized Volatility %
vol_20d.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over a 1-month rolling window.

vol_60d.name: 60-Day Realized Volatility %
vol_60d.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over a 1-quarter rolling window.

vol_ratio.name: Short/Long Volatility Ratio
vol_ratio.description: Term structure ratio of short-term (5d) to quarterly (60d) volatility. Values > 1 indicate volatility shocks.

ewma_vol.name: EWMA Volatility % (RiskMetrics)
ewma_vol.description: Exponentially weighted moving average volatility placing heavier weight on recent trading shocks.

parkinson_vol.name: Parkinson High-Low Volatility %
parkinson_vol.description: Extreme-value volatility estimator utilizing intraday High and Low prices (5x more efficient than Close-to-Close).

parkinson_vol_10d.name: 10-Day Parkinson Volatility %
parkinson_vol_10d.description: 10-day moving average of intraday Parkinson range volatility.

skew_30d.name: 30-Day Rolling Skewness
skew_30d.description: Third standardized moment; measures asymmetric tail risk. Negative values signal fat left downside tails.

kurt_30d.name: 30-Day Rolling Kurtosis
kurt_30d.description: Excess kurtosis measuring outlier tail probability relative to a Gaussian bell curve.

beta_60d.name: 60-Day Benchmark Beta
beta_60d.description: Rolling 60-day systematic market sensitivity relative to benchmark (QQQ).

vix_level.name: CBOE VIX Index Level
vix_level.description: Market-implied volatility fear gauge derived from S&P 500 index options.

vix_change_5d.name: 5-Day VIX Velocity %
vix_change_5d.description: 5-day percentage change in the VIX index, measuring speed of market panic onset.

rel_volume_20d.name: Relative Volume vs 20d Average
rel_volume_20d.description: Ratio of current trading volume to its 20-day moving average. Surges > 1.5 indicate institutional participation.

presets.name: Calm Bull Day (2024-06-12)
presets.description: Low VIX fear (< 13.5), muted volatility ratio, steady upward price momentum.

presets.name: Volatility Panic Spike (2023-03-15)
presets.description: Sharp VIX escalation (> 25), high short-to-long volatility ratio (> 1.4), surging volume.

presets.name: Tail Crash Reversal (2024-08-02)
presets.description: Steep single-day selloff triggering 5% tail loss threshold, heavy negative skewness.

presets.name: Strong Momentum Rally (2024-08-07)
presets.description: High return momentum across multiple lags, positive skew, expanding trading volume.

presets.name: Typical / Median Trading Day (2024-08-27)
presets.description: Median VIX level (~16), moderate Parkinson high-low spread, neutral return momentum.
